name: w08_wrongloads
description: ADVERSARIAL: a pump on an MV incomer, a feeder on a motor, an MCC on a feeder and on an RMU, motor/MCC named on a transformer. Three edges must stay disconnected and every bad row must draw a message. An MCC on a feeder is no longer one of them: a feeder is the way out of a board, so MCCF hangs on FD and the pump under it follows
